snippet.title: Sefton Asylum – You Can’t Save Everyone (Official Reveal Trailer)
snippet.description:
🎮 WISHLIST NOW: [Your Steam Link]

You can’t save everyone. And the ones you lose don’t stay dead.

Become the night nurse of Sefton Asylum — a decaying, post-war hospital where every shift is a race against time, and every mistake has consequences.

---

🩺 CARE. INVESTIGATE. SURVIVE.
Every night, patients flood the wards in critical condition.  
Examine them, diagnose fast, and choose who to treat… before it’s too late.

But you didn’t come here just to work.

Your brother vanished inside Sefton. And somewhere beyond the forbidden west wing, the truth is waiting.

---

⚖️ EVERY CHOICE HAS A COST
Every second you spend investigating is a patient you might lose.  
Every life you fail to save makes the asylum more dangerous.

Because at Sefton…  
the dead don’t always stay dead.

Will you save your patients?  
Find your brother?  
Or shut the asylum down for good?

---

🕯️ GAME FEATURES
• Triage under pressure — stabilize patients before they deteriorate  
• Moral dilemmas — you can’t save everyone  
• Stealth survival — no weapons, hide and evade what hunts you  
• Investigation — uncover forbidden experiments and hidden truths  
• Dynamic horror — your failures shape the nightmare

---
